subject: general
question: Before the launch of which Five-Year Plan did India introduce structural adjustment policies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eighth Five-Year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India introduced structural adjustment policies before the launch of the Eighth Five-Year Plan, in response to its balance of payments crisis.
 
• The Eighth Five-Year Plan covered the period from 1992 to 1997, marking a significant shift in India's economic policy towards liberalization, privatization, and globalization.
 
• These policies aimed at making the Indian economy more market-oriented and expanding the role of private and foreign investment.
 
• Structural adjustments were part of broader economic reforms initiated in 1991, under the leadership of then Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao and Finance Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Seventh Five-Year Plan
 Spanned from 1985 to 1990, focusing on policies that promoted growth and self-reliance.
 
 

 2) Eighth Five-Year Plan
 Marked the beginning of economic reforms and structural adjustment policies in India.
 
 

 3) Sixth Five-Year Plan
 Covered the period from 1980 to 1985, aimed at poverty alleviation and technological self-reliance.
 
 

 4) Ninth Five-Year Plan
 Ran from 1997 to 2002, focusing on social justice and equity alongside economic growth.
